title: One thing at a time — фразы

items.phrase: do one thing at a time
items.example: Do one thing at a time — you'll do more work.
Multi-tasking means doing two things at the same time.
Multi-taskers do less work in an eight-hour day.

items.phrase: not stop talking for more than a few seconds
items.translation: не прерывать разговор больше чем на несколько секунд
items.example: We didn't stop talking for more than a few seconds.
How often do you send a text straightaway?
Do you always answer a text straightaway?
Next week we're going to turn our phones off.

items.translation: не брать ни еды, ни питья
items.example: We'll have no food or drink — just talk and listen.
Your memory gets worse when you multi-task.
You don't listen to your friends carefully.
You make mistakes because you're doing two things at once.

items.phrase: I'll let you know what happens
items.translation: Я дам тебе знать, что получится
items.example: That's my plan — she doesn't know it yet. I'll let you know what happens.

items.translation: Я буду держать тебя в курсе
items.example: We'll turn off our phones — I'll keep you posted.
